# Get data

https://bdoh.inrae.fr/SITE-ATELIER-ARDIERES-MORCILLE/ 

https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/hyp.14384


```{r load-data-from-excel, message = F}

toc <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "guidel.xlsx", sheet = "TOC")

debit <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "guidel.xlsx", sheet = "debit")


guidel <- merge(toc, debit, by = "DateHeure", all = T)
```
